Status of recognition

  1. 1999

    Letter of Permission from the Government of India for 100 MBBS seats.

  2. 2005

    Postgraduate MD/MS courses established in broad specialities.

  3. 2013

    Continuation of recognition for 100 MBBS seats; permission to increase the intake to 150 for 2013–14.

  4. 2018

    Increased intake of 150 MBBS seats recognised by the Central Government (February).

Affiliating university

SVS Medical College is affiliated to Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS), Warangal, Telangana. The current Vice-Chancellor and Registrar are listed on the KNRUHS website ↗.
